content.title: Why can't I connect to the game's servers? - Epic Games Store Support
content.text: Sign in (Opens in a new tab) to get faster help, access self-service tools, and manage your support requests.Why can't I connect to the game's servers?If you're having trouble logging into one of our games or if you were kicked out in the middle of a round or match, it may be due to a server outage. Check the Epic Games Status (Opens in a new tab) page to verify that our servers are up and running.If there is no service outage, check with your Internet Service Provider (ISP) to see if there are any outages or network performance issues with your service.Try rebooting your router.If none of the steps above resolve your issue, please reach out to the manufacturer of your device for further assistance.Was this article helpful?YesNoContact usEpic Support AssistantBy continuing, you agree to our Terms (Opens in a new tab) and acknowledge our Privacy Policy (Opens in a new tab).
